audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and First item read 'Skill' and the 2+ item row read Teemo, contradicting the packet chart and whys[6], which says the two-item window is Vayne's.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank and Vayne's damage is entirely autos, so every stage up to first item is his — 43.69% over 1847 games is the worst matchup in the slice. The one window that belongs to Vayne is two items, where percent-max-health true damage beats his squishy frame if she can land three hits.
audit.corrected: Teemo on six stages, Vayne at 2+ items — matched full/content pairs plus the rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] credits mushroom zoning with holding Levels 4-5. Noxious Trap is his ultimate — there are no mushrooms before 6.
audit.why: Kit: Noxious Trap is the R slot at 600/750/900 range. What actually holds 4-5 is the flat 7s Blinding Dart against an auto-attack pattern. The mirror flagged this same no-mushrooms-before-6 error recurring across the champion.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 are spacing and blind windows; traps start at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two lines say the blind kills Silver Bolts stacking outright. It denies her autos, but Condemn is an ability that still counts as one of the three hits on the same target.
audit.why: Silver Bolts procs on 'the third consecutive attack or ability against the same target' — Condemn is an ability, so blind, then Condemn, still advances the count and can proc the true damage, especially into a wall for the stun. Treating the blind as a total shutdown throws away the one sequence that kills him.
audit.corrected: Blind stops your autos, not Condemn — it still counts toward the third bolt.
sources: kit: Silver Bolts text 'attack or ability'

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blinding Dart's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank, and your whole pattern is autos — step up inside that window and never before it.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blinding Dart's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King lands, but a blind still erases the autos it buys. Fight only in his 7s window.

edits.before: Shroom zoning keeps him ahead through 4-5.
edits.after: Through 4-5 his 7s blind wins the auto trade.

edits.before: Teemo hard-counters your lane: his blind on Q turns off your autos and Silver Bolts stacking, and he out-ranges your poke while kiting with W move-speed — never try to auto-trade while Q is up, just farm and take chip poke passively.
edits.after: Teemo hard-counters your lane: Blinding Dart turns off your autos on a flat 7s and Move Quick kites your poke. But Condemn is an ability, so it still counts as one of the three Silver Bolts hits — save it for a wall, not for chip.

edits.before: Blinding your autos to kill Silver Bolts stacks
edits.after: Blinding your autos so no third bolt lands

edits.before: Through 3-6 his blind, superior range and shroom zoning keep you off every trade; do not dive the mushrooms, build MR boots and scale on CS alone.
edits.after: Through 3-5 his blind and range keep you off every trade, and the traps only arrive at 6; build Mercury's Treads, walk around them, and scale on CS.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is 7s flat — free poke buys him that whole window.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Final Hour's' in spikes[1] — false positive, that is Vayne's own ultimate correctly named, and the line was left alone. The two real errors were mushrooms credited to Levels 4-5 (Noxious Trap is the ultimate) and the blind described as shutting off Silver Bolts entirely, when Condemn still advances the stack.
